artists.biography:
Voyager is an Epic Electro Progressive Pop Power Metal band from Perth, Western Australia. 
The band has released seven full-length albums. Their eighth studio album "Fearless In Love" is scheduled for release on July 14th via Season Of Mist. 
They will represent Australia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2023 with the song "Promise".

perplexity.description:
Voyager’s Colours in the Sun, released in 2019 on Season of Mist, is the Australian band’s seventh studio album and marks their first release with the label. Musically, the album blends progressive rock and metal with strong pop sensibilities, characterized by vibrant synth melodies, soaring vocals, and dynamic guitar work. The band’s signature use of keytar and melodic hooks is prominent throughout, creating a sound that is both energetic and accessible. Tracks like “Brightstar” and “Colours” showcase the band’s ability to balance euphoric, synth-driven intros with powerful riffs and expressive solos, while guest vocals from Einar Solberg of Leprous add further depth to the album’s sonic palette.

In the context of Voyager’s discography, Colours in the Sun is regarded as one of their most consistent and vibrant releases. Critics praised the album for its melodic richness and tight musicianship, with many noting that it stands alongside their previous high points such as Ghost Mile and The Meaning of I. The album received strong reviews, with outlets like Man of Much Metal awarding it a score of 97%, highlighting its ability to maintain the band’s signature style while pushing their sound forward. Though it did not achieve major commercial chart success, Colours in the Sun solidified Voyager’s reputation as a band capable of crafting imaginative, genre-blending rock music that resonates with both prog and mainstream audiences.
